defs.def: a real or imagined line that marks the limits or edges of sth and separates it from other things or places; a dividing line 边界；界限；分界线

ex.s: History has the potential to break down those boundaries by offering us insight into entire worlds that would otherwise be foreign to us.
ex.t: 历史有潜力打破这些界限，让我们深入了解那些对我们来说原本陌生的世界。

ex.s: Set boundaries for yourselfas your time goes
ex.t: 随着时间的推移为自己设定界限

ex.s: Set boundaries for yourself your time goes
ex.t: 随着时间推移，为你自己设定界限。

ex.s: The Fable of the Chicken Some stories have universal appeal: they go beyond the boundaries of individual countries and cultures.
ex.t: 鸡的寓言有些故事具有普遍的吸引力：它们超越了个别国家和文化的界限。

ex.s: I knew I was putting my life at risk, but I thought, “If I don’t do it, who will?” It is important to remember that Ebola doesn’t respect national boundaries.
ex.t: 我知道自己是在拿生命冒险，但我想：“如果我不做，谁会去做？”要记住很重要的一点：埃博拉病毒不分国界。

ex.s: Now it was up to the living to remove not only the divisions between North and South, but the boundaries between black and white, and work step by step towards the equality of humankind.
ex.t: 现在，这个责任落在了活着的人身上：不仅要消除南北之间的分裂，还要消除黑人与白人之间的界限，一步步向着人类平等的目标前进。

ex.s: At a time when relatively little was known about our country in the Western world, his 1937 book Red Star over China broke ideological boundaries by telling the stories of the Chinese communist movement from the inside.
ex.t: 在西方国家对我们国家所知甚少的时代，他1937年的著作《红星照耀中国》从内部讲述了中国共产主义运动的故事，打破了意识形态的界限。

ex.s: Opening Who the person is: What boundary he / she has broken: Body How he / she achieved this: Summary Comments on him / her: Now write your speech.
ex.t: 开头　此人是谁：他/她打破了什么界限：身体　他/她如何做到：总结　对他的评价：现在写你的演讲稿。

ex.s: Taken informally, the budget line describes the boundary of affordability for a given budget and specific goods.
ex.t: 从非正式角度看，预算线描述的是给定预算和特定商品下的支付能力边界。

defs.def: a hit of the ball that crosses the boundary of the playing area and scores extra points 板球
